kaya: Kaya [fr. kri] 구입, 사기 A III.226 (+vi°). --(a)kkaya, 사기 & 팔기 Pv I.56 (see also Kh VII.6 and note). --vikkaya (kraya vikraya) 사기 & 팔기, 거래 in °paṭivirata D I.5=A II.209=V.205= Pug 58; D I.64; S V.473; Sn 929; J V.243; Khus 114; DhA I.78; PvA 29 (=KhA 212). perhaps connected with kṛ] to buy; Inf. ketuṁ J III.282; cp. kiṇāti.
kayika: Kayika [fr. krī, cp. BSk. krayika Divy 505] 구매자, 상인, 거래인 Miln 334.
